authority: Agent technical decision under the maintainer standing routine-development delegation of 2026-11-09.

contract.goal: Recover an existing task boundary after a report was created in its authorized workspace subdirectory, without replaying completed writes.
not_doing: A new task or report runtime
A complete Stage A or Stage B claim
Real provider calls, tags, releases or package uploads
contract.done_when: Focused real-filesystem tests bind the nested output path/hash, resume only pending steps, ignore root-level same-name files and refuse externally changed nested outputs; scoped review and exact-candidate CI/main readback complete routine delivery.
contract.evidence: This record and tests/test_plan_recovery.py; exact integration evidence is read back separately.
contract.budget_stop: One bounded recovery defect; do not touch the active terminal slice. At most three review rounds; expand only for a new finding in the changed path.
contract.rollback: Revert this isolated change via an ordinary reviewed commit; never rewrite prior task reports or shared Git history.

alternatives: Use the record workspace_root to translate tool-relative paths to caller-workspace evidence paths (selected).
Change all tools to emit absolute paths (rejected: changes existing record contracts).
Relocate execution reports into subdirectories (rejected: breaks stable report lookup).
design.selected: Translate the completed tool path once at the existing evidence collector. Preserve current report schema, root-workspace behavior and strict resume verification.
design.root_cause: Task tools record paths relative to the narrowed TaskPolicy workspace_root, but _changed_files interpreted them relative to the caller workspace. Recovery already expects workspace_root/path.

plan: Add red nested-root evidence, same-name collision and tamper-refusal regressions.
Join the recorded workspace root before existing evidence resolution; keep the rest of the collector unchanged.
Run focused execution/recovery tests and lint, document exact evidence coordinates, review only this diff, then controlled branch/PR/CI/main integration.
